Jalen Brunson scored the Knicks' first basket more than anyone in 2025-26: 29 times in 92 starts, or 32% of the games they started. Mikal Bridges was next with 21. The Knicks made the game's first field goal in 58% of their 100 games and won 49% of their opening tipoffs. Everything below is counted from the play-by-play of every 2025-26 game (1,225 regular season, 85 playoffs, 6 play-in).
